codeReview.summary: Reviewed the feature handoff, transcript skeleton, and commit b3e02762. The browser bootstrap fix in e2e/helpers.ts correctly persists both token and workspace id before dashboard navigation, and the daemon background launcher now forwards the resolved worktree server URL into the child process. I did not find a concrete correctness bug in the committed changes themselves.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The validation-hardening-worker skill requires agent-browser confirmation, but this feature was completed using Playwright and CLI inspection instead because local daemon auth was invalid. The skill does not document that a broken local PAT/workspace watch prerequisite can make browser confirmation impossible even after the code fix is correct.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff skillFeedback marks procedure not followed for step 6 and explains browser validation was blocked by `POST /api/daemon/register returned 401: {"error":"invalid token"}` while .factory/library/user-testing.md now documents the PAT/workspace watch prerequisite.

summary: Pass. The reviewed commit makes the intended bootstrap and daemon-start hardening changes, and I found no high-confidence actionable bug in the diff.
